description: Workflow Phase 0 control experiment. A random-signal, dollar-neutral, unit-gross trader at the real strategy's cadence, routed through the identical target->order->fill->ledger path. Expected net P&L = -(costs). Anything better than that is a bug in the fill or accounting logic and must be found before any real signal is trusted. Capital is 640,000 USD = 90% of the account's USD-equivalent equity (the account is CAD-denominated); the USD gross limit is sized to that, not to a notional 1M.

limits._suspend_note: Effectively disabled 2026-07-31 on standing instruction: paper deployment exists to generate data and a suspended book stops producing it. Drawdown is reported in the daily log for human review. Broker margin limits still apply and are not ours to disable.
